_doc: Live view for pin-watch (sensor_dash.py --app). BTN btn1..btnN = 1 while pressed (names/pins: 'buttons'). EVT and PINCHG lines go to the log; PINCHG P<port>.<pin>=0|1 names the MCU pin of any input that changes - press 'watch arm' first so unused pins have their input buffer on. The bridge keeps the raw log (<app>/logs/liveview-*.log).
title: Buttons + pin watch
